findings.text: follow-on: run_all_audits appends only run_house_style_checks, so the sign-convention class the brief and plan §4 require to reach the AuditReport (via docs_gates.py:512 score_documentation) still does not, leaving one of the five lint classes unread by the reviewer.

follow-on: the census test asserts only that the finding-class set is a subset of the enum and that fewer than 220 names lack an entry; the per-class counts the fragment publishes are printed and not asserted, so a drift in the counts would not redden.

follow-on: _template_opening_findings flags a finding for every template the opening fails to match rather than only when it matches none, so a name selecting more than one template would over-fire; the registry currently holds a single template entry, so this is latent and not reachable today.
follow-on: the _classes helper is defined and never called.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit 489a1a81 against base c833c0a16; one commit, four files, +513/-1, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names the carbon dl/B and argon line-form equations flagged, the beryllium surface form not flagged, a separatrix gloss flagged, a canonical entry at zero findings, and a recorded WEST census; tests/standard_names/test_house_style_checks.py:57 asserts the fixtures and census.log records the per-class census.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is to add registry-driven conformance findings to the docs_gates checks and route them into the review AuditReport; imas_codex/standard_names/docs_gates.py:654 house_style_findings and imas_codex/standard_names/review/audits.py:728 implement that.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it states units 10 passed, census 1 passed, the docs_gates/audits gate 77 passed against an identical baseline, with baseline_suite and after_suite completed:true and three negative-control logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares docs_gates.py, review/audits.py, the new test file and the fragment; the diff touches exactly those four paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: each of the four checks has a revert-sensitive test shown red by negative_forbidden_variant/symbol_spelling/template_opening logs, though the census test tests/standard_names/test_house_style_checks.py:191 asserts only class membership and not the per-class counts it records.
justifications.evidence: tests/standard_names/test_house_style_checks.py:57 asserts each done_when fixture and census.log prints census {'forbidden_equation_variant': 1, 'template_opening': 1, 'forbidden_locus_gloss': 1} no_entry 188 parse_failures 1, reconciling with the fragment's per-class counts.
justifications.fit: the additions follow the module's StrEnum/frozen-dataclass/private-helper idiom at docs_gates.py:514 and carry no plan label, though tests/standard_names/test_house_style_checks.py:47 defines an unused _classes helper.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs_gates.py:654 house_style_findings and review/audits.py:728 deliver four of the five plan §4 classes to the AuditReport, but the sign-convention class (docs_gates.py:429 _sign_convention_result, aggregated by docs_gates.py:512 score_documentation) still never reaches it though the brief names run_all_audits calling the documentation gates.
justifications.reuse: select_conventions/forbidden_variants/forbidden_spellings are consumed nowhere else in imas_codex (git grep), so docs_gates.py:654 extends the ISN registry owner rather than forking it, and ISN owns no template-opening matcher.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff c833c0a16..489a1a81 touches only docs_gates.py, review/audits.py, tests/standard_names/test_house_style_checks.py and the fragment, the fragment inside the declared write paths.
